survivors_flagged.one_line: Mitapivat sickle-cell sNDA: PDUFA moved to 2027-02-01 after a REMS-related major amendment. Stock fell 18% ($37->$31) and the company says it is in labeling talks, so the binary is de-rated and still about 10 weeks out. Drug already approved in two indications.

FDA decisions on AVT05 (golimumab), AVT06 (aflibercept) and AVT16 expected Q4 2026, about early Dec if six months from the Jun-4 resubmission. Reykjavik inspection closed VAI in Jul and the DSM2 suite was approved in Oct, so CRL risk is lower. Stock already jumped 19% on the resubmission, so this is mid-arc and partly priced.

verified.catalyst: FDA decision on the mitapivat sickle-cell sNDA (accelerated approval, Priority Review) by the extended PDUFA goal date of 2027-02-01. The FDA extended the date after it classed Agios' answer to its question on whether a REMS is needed as a major amendment. Agios says it is launch-ready and in labeling talks.
verified.dated_milestone: PDUFA 2027-02-01 (original date 2026-11-01, extended on 2026-10-30). Before that: ASH 2026 in early December, with new mitapivat sickle-cell data.
verified.instrument: AGIO common stock (NASDAQ). Last $28.76, market cap $1.72B, $907M cash at 9/30/26, so about $15/share in cash and about $0.8B EV.
verified.bloom_gates: G1: yes, FDA is the named counterparty. G2: yes, the PDUFA date of 2027-02-01 is a concrete regulatory commitment. G3: partial. The de-rating can be measured (pre-delay about $37, now $28.76), but the commercial size of a sickle-cell label that carries a REMS and missed the pain-crisis endpoint is not a hard figure.
verified.edge: M-. Run-up from the pre-catalyst base is about -22%, not a gain: the stock was about $37 before the 10/30 delay and is $28.76 now, below the $31 the triage quoted. It had also fallen about 29% in the three months to early October on the tebapivat setbacks. So nothing has been harvested, and the residual is all de-rating. Remaining capture is about +29% to roughly $37 on an approval with REMS, against about -20 to -25% to roughly $22-23 on a CRL (the stock still holds the thalassemia and PKD franchises, about $220M annualized, plus about $15/share in cash). Taking about 70% for approval, the probability-weighted value is about $32.5, roughly +13%. Reward/risk is about 1.2-1.4x. The FDA's concern is safety and REMS, not efficacy, and the liver-monitoring REMS already exists for AQVESME. That is the argument that the market over-discounts. Against it, the sickle-cell efficacy is mixed (pain-crisis endpoint missed, transfusion benefit shown), so even an approval may bring only modest uptake.
verified.primary_source: Agios press release 2026-10-30, 'New PDUFA Goal Date of February 1, 2027' (GlobeNewswire). Agios Q3 2026 results 2026-11-05 (GlobeNewswire). FMP quote 2026-11-20 ($28.76).
verified.analysis: Verified from primary sources. On 2026-10-30 the FDA extended the mitapivat sickle-cell PDUFA to 2027-02-01 after it classed Agios' REMS information response as a major amendment, and Agios says it is in labeling talks that include possible REMS elements. The Q3 release on 2026-11-05 confirms $55.4M quarterly mitapivat revenue and $907M in cash. The event is real, dated, forward, unfired and not a macro bet, and the stock trades below its pre-delay base, so nothing is harvested. The score stays at 5 because the upside on approval is moderate (about +29%) against a meaningful CRL downside, mixed efficacy limits the commercial value of a sickle-cell label with a REMS, and the binary is about 10 weeks out. Gap: the web-search budget was exhausted, so the approval probability, share count and any debt were not checked against the 10-Q. No capital-structure provenance was needed because this is a binary lane with no derived SoP numerator, but the cash figure is taken from the press release.

verified.catalyst: FDA decisions on the AVT05 (golimumab, Simponi), AVT06 (aflibercept 2mg, Eylea) and AVT03 (denosumab) biosimilar BLAs, all expected in December 2026 after the Reykjavik site cleared VAI.
verified.dated_milestone: FDA action dates in December 2026; management said "December" on the Q3 call of 2026-11-11/12, no exact BsUFA day disclosed. Next: the December FDA letters, then the Simponi preliminary-injunction ruling that gates the AVT05 launch.
verified.bloom_gates: G1 (FDA is the named counterparty on 3 filed BLAs) + G2 (dated December action). G3 not met: there is no contractual figure. The approval value is a judgement re-rating, and the $8.50 consensus target was NOT re-derived.
verified.edge: M. The event is real, dated and unfired. The site risk is retired (FDA closed the Reykjavik inspection as VAI on 2026-07-29, and the DS suites were approved 2026-10-05 and 10-20), so CRL odds are lower than a typical binary. Run-up from the pre-catalyst base: +37% ($3.14 close on 2026-06-03, the day before the resubmission, to $4.29). Remaining to my favorable-resolution value (~$5.30, a reclaim of the 50-day average / post-approval re-rate): about +24%. The downside to the pre-event base (~$3.00-3.14) is about -27%. The stock has already given back the move from its $6.53 high after the Q3 miss, so this is NOT mostly harvested, but the payoff is roughly symmetric (RR ~0.8; probability-weighted at ~75% approval, about +10%).
verified.primary_source: Alvotech Q3/9M results press release, GlobeNewswire 2026-11-11, and the Q3 call summary, MarketBeat 2026-11-12 (December FDA decisions, cash $61M, low-end guidance). Also the FDA VAI inspection closure, GlobeNewswire 2026-07-29, and FMP quote/EOD price history to 2026-11-20 (pre-event close $3.14 on 2026-06-03).
verified.analysis: The December FDA decisions for AVT05, AVT06 and AVT03 are confirmed, forward and unfired: no approval had been announced by 2026-11-20. Manufacturing-site risk, the cause of the earlier CRL, has been retired. The equity case is weaker than the event. Cash fell to $61M at Q3 (from $143M), interest was $37M in the quarter, FY26 guidance is now at the low end ($650M revenue / $180M adj. EBITDA, implying a heroic Q4 of ~$327M revenue), and the CFO would not rule out raising capital. The AVT05 launch also faces a pending Simponi preliminary-injunction motion, and the controlling holder pledged its shares in June 2026. I could not verify total debt or the GoldenTree loan terms from the 10-Q, because web search was exhausted and the GlobeNewswire release returned 403. So the approval value is a judgement re-rating, not a waterfall-derived one. That gap and the near-symmetric payoff keep this at WATCH 5, not ACTIVE.
